fact: On 1 December 2025 the minister delegate said the ministry is drawing up a Cloud Services roadmap 2025-2030 whose first pillar is a national Cloud First policy requiring priority use of cloud in all new IT projects of public administrations, with a national steering committee and a sovereign national cloud planned for the State's sensitive systems.
title: Pour Seghrouchni, l'adoption du Cloud, levier essentiel pour la souveraineté numérique
